name: php-mcrypt-size-t-to-int
fixed_note: Fix bug #72551 and bug #72552 - check before converting size_t->int: mcrypt_generic/mdecrypt_generic sized the buffer with data_size = (int)data_len and copied data_len bytes; the fix rejects a length the cast changed (PHP 7.0.9)
setup_note: ext/mcrypt needs mcrypt.h (libmcrypt-dev); configure --disable-all only generates main/php_config.h, and HAVE_LIBMCRYPT is passed on the command line
